text: yes that is in part why we have framework/world/streaming.zig should handle all of that
resolution: Made framework/world/streaming.zig the direct residency authority for both baked and live-painted worlds. Painted terrain and foliage use its footprint radius and demotion hysteresis, the duplicate paint_residency module was removed, and registered unit coverage proves 21 terrain chunks versus 9 foliage chunks at default tuning.
